en: By fourteen, they placed him in charge
zh: 十四岁时，众人就让他掌管
note: by fourteen 是「到十四岁时」；in charge of 的宾语被断到下一行。
next_note: of a trading charter 接上一行：掌管一份贸易特许状。charter 是殖民政府发的贸易许可。

next_zh: 在姑娘们中间很吃得开！
note: reliable 单独成行是为押韵；完整意思是 reliable with the ladies。
next_note: with the ladies 接上一行；Ladies! 同时是副歌的钩子。

en: He’s a bit of a flirt
next_en: but I’m a give it a chance
note: a bit of a flirt = 有点爱调情的人；这句在「but」处断，前后都是完整意思。
next_note: but I’m a give it a chance = 不过我想给他一次机会；I’m a 是 I’m going to 的口语。

next_en: the homilies and hymns won’t teach ya
next_zh: 是讲道和圣歌教不了你的
note: that 引出定语从句，先行词在下一行：things that the homilies… won’t teach ya。
next_note: homily 布道；hymn 赞美诗；teach ya = teach you。

next_zh: 这个国家诞生后的血污
note: Watching 单独成行，宾语留到下一行，制造悬念。
next_note: afterbirth 是胎盘；把建国比作分娩后的血污，意象阴冷。

en: Raised enough for me to book passage
next_en: on a ship that was New York bound…
note: book passage = 订船票；on a ship 被断到下一行。
next_note: New York bound = 开往纽约的；-bound 后缀表方向。

en: I’ll give him this: his financial system
zh: 这一点我承认：他的财政体系
next_en: is a work of genius. I couldn’t undo it if I tried
next_zh: 是天才之作，我就算想拆也拆不掉
note: I’ll give him this 是让步句的开头：这一点我承认他。
next_note: a work of genius = 天才之作；couldn’t undo it if I tried 是虚拟条件。
